XTransfer debuts at FELABAN to streamline LatAm SME cross-border payments. 🇨🇦

### Financial Markets & Infrastructure
Bank of Xiamen issued China's first digital currency-backed green financial bond, deploying e-CNY to establish a programmatic asset settlement benchmark. This issuance demonstrates the operational readiness of central bank digital currencies for automated and verifiable sustainable finance flows. Advisory practices can structure consulting engagements to design programmable CBDC workflows and smart contract validation layers for complex capital market issuances.

### Cross-Border Payments & Compliance
Cryptoasset providers and stablecoin issuers face regulatory convergence as authorities apply traditional correspondent banking AML, CFT, and sanctions logic directly to virtual asset service providers. Firms must operationalize robust counterparty due diligence, secondary market transaction screening, and liquidity access controls. Risk practices can propose specialized compliance assessments to map counterparty screening architectures against traditional [SWIFT](https://www.swift.com/) correspondent banking standards.

### Global Payment Speed & Infrastructure
With half of international payments on Swift reaching the beneficiary bank within 40 seconds, primary friction has shifted decisively from international messaging rails to domestic clearing leg bottlenecks. As institutions navigate post-ISO 20022 implementation landscapes, end-to-end processing transparency becomes a critical competitive differentiator for corporate treasuries. Advisory teams can propose targeted treasury diagnostics to audit internal routing paths, identify domestic clearing latency, and optimize liquidity frameworks.

### Corporate Treasury & Digital Assets
Traditional banking partners face mounting modernization pressures as 64% of businesses adopt non-bank international payout methods and digital assets approach over 20% of B2B volume by 2035. The operational challenge centers on integrating stablecoins and tokenized deposits without introducing manual reconciliation friction or fragmented reporting into legacy treasury workflows. Consultancies can evaluate how traditional correspondent networks ingest tokenized liquidity assets while maintaining ISO 20022 messaging interoperability.

### Trade Settlement & Regional Expansion
XTransfer expanded into Latin America at the 60th FELABAN, deploying global local collection networks to bypass USD friction points and reduce FX costs for underserved exporters. Integrating artificial intelligence-driven risk management allows platforms to achieve ultra-low fraud rates while maintaining transparent channels aligned with international financial integrity mandates. Financial advisory practices can partner with regional institutions to integrate modern B2B trade settlement networks, focusing on API-driven compliance frameworks and ISO 20022 alignment.
